title: test(ui): repository walkers tolerate tsup's transient bundled config vanishing mid-walk
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBFipqCKL82rffBrxJjboxqk)_

Fixes #30256

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：三个扫描整个仓库的测试，读文件时不再因为 tsup 构建临时写入又删掉的 `tsup.config.bundled_*.mjs` 而报 ENOENT；只改测试文件，不改产品代码。
- 为什么改：`strict-authoring-face-8345` 在合并队列里与并行分片的 tsup 构建竞态（队列构建 41962914067，`Test UI (4/16)`），把无关 PR 踢出队列。
- 风险与回滚：只容忍 ENOENT（读之前文件消失）；其他读错误照样抛出，`scanned > 1000` 和唯一导入者断言一字未改。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`strict-authoring-face-8345.test.ts` 中提取出的 `scanForImporters` / `readIfPresent` 和新增的竞态钉子测试。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/src/__tests__/strict-authoring-face-8345.test.ts`，预期 33 例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位审阅并落地。

## What changes

- **`ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/strict-authoring-face-8345.test.ts`** — the importer walk is extracted to `scanForImporters(repoRoot, roots, list?)` inside the same `describe`. Two guards, placed as #20225 / #20269 placed them:
  - a file named `*.bundled_<hash>.mjs` (tsup's transient bundle of `tsup.config.ts`) is skipped by name;
  - `readIfPresent` returns `undefined` on **ENOENT only** and the file is not counted; every other read fault re-throws.
  - `scanned` now counts files actually read (it used to count before the read). The `scanned > 1000` floor and the `['packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts']` importer assertion are unchanged.
- **New race pin** in the same file drives the extracted walker over a temp directory with a doctored listing: a vanished `tsup.config.bundled_x.mjs` and a vanished `vanished.ts` → no throw, `scanned: 1`, only `pkg/real.ts` found; an on-disk `tsup.config.bundled_y.mjs` carrying a specifier → skipped by name; a directory listed as a file → still throws `EISDIR`. The fixture's import line is split so this file never reads as an importer itself.
- **Sweep, same race, fixed here** (walk reaches `ui/packages/cli`, a tsup package root, and reads `.mjs`):
  - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/__tests__/block-config-i18n.test.ts` (`shippedLiteralKeys`, walks `packages` + `apps`, ext `(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs)`).
  - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/select-placeholder-literal-11252.test.ts` (walks `packages` + `apps`, `SOURCE_FILE` includes `mjs`; `filesRead` now counts files actually read).
  - Each got the same two guards inline. No shared helper: the three sites live in two packages and a cross-package test import would add a dependency edge for ten lines.

## Why

tsup bundles each package's `tsup.config.ts` to `tsup.config.bundled_<hash>.mjs` beside it and deletes it when the build ends. A walk that lists the directory during a concurrent build can name that file and then fail to read it. `readdirSync` was already guarded; the per-file `readFileSync` was not.

## Verification

- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run` on the three touched files: 3 files, 58 tests passed (under `os-verify-lock`, exit 0).
- **CONTROL**: the importer test still finds exactly `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts`.
- **Ablations** on the race pin (each restored byte-identical after):
  1. ENOENT guard removed (`throw err` unconditionally) → pin red.
  2. Name skip removed → pin red (on-disk bundle read as an importer).
  3. Guard widened to every error → pin red (`EISDIR` no longer thrown).
- Sweep findings not fixed (read only; none reaches a tsup package root with an `.mjs` read): `machineLocaleCensus-9909` reads `[cm]?[jt]sx?` at package roots, but its population (packages depending on `@object-ui/i18n`) excludes `cli`, `create-plugin`, `data-objectstack`; `page-node-headings-drawn-11436` walks `examples` only (no tsup there); `sidebarGroupLabel.callSites-12795` (`tsx?|jsx?|mts`, no `.mjs`); `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet` lists paths but does not read them; the rest walk `src/` only or filter to `.ts`/`.tsx`/`.json`.
